nextWork.title: 0.4.5 operator publish and installed-package recycle
nextWork.operatorGuidance: Commit T-0601, then run the operator-controlled 0.4.5 npm/GitHub publish flow from a clean ext4 clone and follow with installed-package recycle against hadara@0.4.5.

nextOperatorIntent: Commit T-0601, publish hadara@0.4.5 from a clean clone, then run post-publish installed-package recycle.

currentKnownProblems.summary: Task-scoped context pack is about 8-10s on the mounted WSL repository.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Prefer bounded status/session paths; revisit performance only with an explicit trust/cache design.

currentKnownProblems.summary: Explicit live graph and context reads remain filesystem-sensitive.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Warm cache first and opt into broad live diagnostics deliberately.

currentKnownProblems.summary: Tool-host child process launch can return EPERM while direct commands pass.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Run the command directly, then record it through validation run --direct-result.

currentKnownProblems.summary: Release artifact git-status preflight and full dev Docker workspace copy can exceed useful latency on the mounted WSL workspace.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Use the clean publish ext4 worktree for release artifacts and treat the direct /workspace Docker build path as the fallback when sync-copy stalls.

validationBaseline.summary: T-0601 fixed the post-T-0600 clean-clone test regressions and Docker validation passed: build, focused clean-clone regressions, and full 153-file/1096-test suite.
